name: Scout Support
summary: High Executor Darthalia sends you with updated orders for Deathstalker Masoj, south of Tarren Mill. Your delivery supports the Forsaken effort to take control of these lands.

sections.title: Orders for Masoj
sections.body: Darthalia says you can be trusted with information for the forward spies. She gives you updated orders for Masoj, who is posted on high ground north of Nethander Stead, outside Dun Garok. The Forsaken plan to take control of these lands continues, and Masoj is waiting for the orders.

faq.answer: High Executor Darthalia gave you updated orders for Deathstalker Masoj.
Deathstalker Masoj is a forward spy posted outside Dun Garok, north of Nethander Stead.
Masoj is south of Tarren Mill, on elevated ground north of Nethander Stead and outside Dun Garok.

faq.q: What am I carrying to Masoj?
faq.answer: You are carrying updated orders for Deathstalker Masoj.
The delivery supports the Forsaken plan to take control of these lands.
